Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/security/filter/SecurityDefenseFilter.java only.
- Extends OncePerRequestFilter, @Component.
- Autowire SecurityDefenseService via constructor.
- Extracts client IP address (checks X-Forwarded-For header first, falls back to request.getRemoteAddr()).
- Applies rate limit check: for '/api/auth/**' max 30 req/min, for others max 120 req/min.
- If exceeded, sets response status 429 (TOO_MANY_REQUESTS), writes JSON error body {error: 'Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 60 seconds.'}, and returns without continuing filter chain.
